learningGoals: To learn and use daily greeting words like 'Good morning' and 'Good night' 🌞
To confidently introduce themselves to others using simple sentences 🙋‍♂️
To understand the magic of polite words like 'Please' and 'Thank you' 🙏
To practice listening and speaking in English during everyday routines 🏡
teachingTips: Start every day by greeting your child with a cheerful 'Good morning!' to set a natural example. 🌅
Encourage them to introduce themselves to family members or visiting friends playfully. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
Use 'Please' and 'Thank you' regularly around the house so they naturally copy your good manners. ✨
Make bedtime special by always ending the day with a warm 'Good night.' 🛌

funActivities.title: The Sun and Moon Game 🌜
funActivities.description: Show pictures of daytime and nighttime, or point outside. Ask your child to cheerfully say 'Good morning' for the sun and 'Good night' for the moon.

funActivities.title: Teddy Bear Introductions 🧸
funActivities.description: Grab their favorite toys and act out a meeting. Have the toy say, 'Hello, my name is Teddy! What is your name?' and let your child practice replying.

funActivities.title: The Magic Words Star Chart ⭐
funActivities.description: Every time your child remembers to use 'Please', 'Thank you', or 'Sorry' without being reminded, draw a little star on a chart. Celebrate when they collect five stars!
